answer: Harberger-taxed identity slots stop bulk fakes. Each identity claims one marble slot, locks a 70-credit bond, and self-prices it. A lantern publishes every price; anyone may buy a slot at its declared price. The buyer signs with a quill; a rented signature burns both bonds. Each fake pays 5% tax: at 1,000, 50 per epoch, so 1,000 fakes pay 50,000 and lock 70,000 against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent prices once, pays 50, and keeps its share.
